observed_problem: V8 inferred planner-role absence from required_marker_groups alone, even though the same case already contained navigation meaning in jp_summary and human_speech_plan.content_units. V4 also rejected plausible synonyms such as へろへろ and 終わって.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A source-separated audit of planning evidence and reply evidence will show whether each V4 missing-required failure is a true planner omission, a planned role that was not realized, or a lexical scorer vocabulary gap. If the V8 target role is already present in the plan but absent from the reply, the next causal variable belongs at the planner-to-RightBrain realization interface rather than planner content generation.
single_changed_variable: evaluation attribution only: required-marker-only role coverage is replaced by separate planning-evidence and reply-evidence classification

classification_policy.planner_role_missing: The role has no planning evidence, regardless of reply score.
classification_policy.lexical_scorer_gap: The role is planned and the reply contains a preregistered concept marker that the frozen lexical scorer did not accept.
classification_policy.planned_but_unrealized: The role is planned but neither the frozen scorer nor the broader preregistered reply-concept markers observe it.
classification_policy.not_applicable: No missing_required reason exists for the role.

evidence_boundary: V9 audits known development plans and frozen V8 replies. It can correct causal attribution and authorize one new preregistration, but cannot retroactively change V8 scores, establish unseen-context generalization, validate public-persona fidelity, or enable runtime behavior.
